name: Pumpkin Chana Soup
ingredients: Black pepper, salt and lemon juice
1 tbsp pumpkin seeds, optional (omit for seed allergies)
steps: Heat the oil, add cumin and onion and cook for 5 minutes until golden.
Add garlic and coriander powder, then the pumpkin and stock.
Simmer covered for 15 minutes until the pumpkin is completely soft.
Add half the chickpeas and blend until smooth. Stir in the remaining whole chickpeas.
Season with salt, pepper and lemon juice.
note: Pumpkin gives natural sweetness, so no cream or sugar is needed.
